- API enablement live lab (hands-on, requires keys and terminal access)

B) Two shorter blocks on the same day (e.g., 09:30–10:30 console, 14:00–15:30 lab)
C) Split across two consecutive days (morning product, afternoon lab)

Ben and Soojin are copied — Ben can lead the lab, Soojin will cover console features and the admin controls. I've attached a draft agenda and a short prework checklist for the lab (keys + sample prompts).

If you can tell us which option you prefer and any timezone constraints, we'll send calendar holds and update the agenda.
